description:
Qumulo is a software-defined cloud data platform. Our core is a distributed storage operating system in C & Rust, holding exabytes in the datacenter, at the edge, and natively in the cloud. Qumulo serves everything from a hospital's medical imaging archive to an animation studio's render farm in an environment where 99% correct doesn’t cut it.

About the Role:

Joining us, you'd learn and work across our distributed storage engine and the services that help customers store, manage, and protect their data, under the guidance of experienced senior engineers.

This includes a fault-tolerant block layer that erasure-codes and distributes data beneath the file system, a transactional file system where aggregates roll up as they change so a query across billions of files answers in real time instead of walking a tree, and that same machinery drives quotas, capacity trends, snapshot policy, multiple access protocols, plus replication and backup - all running in userspace.

All of which makes Qumulo a distributed operating system problem: scheduling, memory hierarchy, protection, and concurrency. We're AI-forward and specific about what that means. You will learn to use agents to help write code while developing your engineering judgment to ensure every design decision is correct, because nothing ships that isn't right.

Why join Qumulo:

Qumulo blends the flexibility of a startup with the security of a mature and profitable organization. Here you’ll work closely with a small team of smart, capable engineers who will serve as your mentors. Opinions are expected, disagreement is normal, and you'll get hands-on experience taking projects from ideation to release. We value quality, correctness, and performance. Our architecture, protocols, and patents are public, so you can read how most of this works before you talk to us - and we’re small enough that the work you do will actually show up in the product.

As a Software Engineer at Qumulo, you will:

 - Collaborate with team members on design, code reviews, and pair programming to deliver high-quality software.

 - Collaborate with team members and area leads on architecture and design of new/updated features.

 - Contribute to full-lifecycle feature development and testing using C, Rust, and Python.

 - Take ownership of defining and implementing customer-facing features and internal system improvements.

 - Help debug, troubleshoot, and fix test failures and complex product or service issues in production environments.

What we're looking for:

 - Recently graduated (or graduating within the next 9 months) with a degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Ability to write well-factored, maintainable, and well-tested code.

 - Strong grasp of algorithms and data structures, with solid academic or project experience in distributed systems, database concepts, concurrent programming, or operating systems concepts.

 - Proficiency in C, C++, Rust, Java, or Go demonstrated through classes, internships, or personal projects

 - Willingness to work collaboratively with a team to solve complex problems and learn quickly on the job.

 - Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our downtown Seattle HQ

Must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or transfer. This role is hybrid, based at our downtown Seattle HQ, targeting 3 days a week in-office.

The salary range for this role is USD $110,000 - $140,000 annual base salary plus pre-IPO stock options and benefits. Individual compensation depends on factors such as role level, relevant experience, and skill set.

Benefits & Perks:

 - Pre-IPO stock options

 - Flexible time-off policy

 - HSA and PPO health insurance options

 - Dental and Vision insurance

 - 401(k) plan

 - Choice of an ORCA card or parking subsidy



About Qumulo:
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.

Our Values: 
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.
